cases.name: a-formula-as-a-field-of-a-compound
cases.description: A formula as a field of a compound is refused: a record's parts are drawn and rearranged together, and a computed value moved to another row no longer describes it. One cell of the placement matrix, pinned so every implementation refuses it at the same place.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="p" local="en"><pool name="P" count="3"><sequence name="n"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" value="2020-01-01..2020-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="K"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen name="f" type="formula" expr="N * 2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>
